title: THE PARTY FRAME STAYS CLEAR OF THE CREDITS
why: Seen on the 4K PARTY screenshot of 2026-10-08: in a window about 830 menu pixels tall (1080p or 1440p fullscreen, or a 4K window) the PARTY frame top line ran 33 pixels down, straight under the CREDITS readout in the corner. The frame now keeps 75 pixels clear of the top and bottom; the party content still fits with room.
now: The PARTY window frame no longer runs under the credits in the corner.

edits.anchor: #partymodal::before{ inset:50% auto auto 50%; width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 28px)); height:min(760px,calc(100% - 28px)); transform:translate(-50%,-50%); }
